summary: Lakeshore Freight is a carrier with about 380 people. It started with its main terminal and 14 dispatchers, and ran the exception board there for eight weeks.
quote: We stopped hearing about late loads from customers. In eight weeks the Friday call volume fell by almost half, and dispatch stopped working Saturdays.
chart_title: Late-load calls per week at the main terminal

summary: Fernbrook Animal Hospital has four clinics and about 90 people. It moved online booking and reminders to one schedule across all four, starting with the busiest clinic.
quote: Our front desk used to spend the morning calling people who forgot. Now most of them confirm with one tap.
chart_title: Missed appointments per week across the four clinics

summary: Harbor Light Software is a 120-person company that moved its support queue and handoffs into one view.
quote: Our weekly status meeting got shorter because the board already says what is stuck.
chart_title: Open tickets older than five days
